The '''''Pulsar''''' was a [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] in [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s forces around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Along with three [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboats]], it engaged the ''[[FarStar]]'' shortly after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] corvette had left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Binaros]].
